CREATE TYPE api_key_status AS ENUM ('active', 'revoked')
CREATE TYPE experience_role AS ENUM ('admin', 'manager', 'user')
CREATE TYPE assistant_status AS ENUM ('draft', 'active', 'disabled')
CREATE TYPE chat_role AS ENUM ('system', 'user', 'assistant', 'tool')
CREATE TYPE knowledge_base_status AS ENUM ('empty', 'building', 'ready', 'failed', 'archived')
CREATE TYPE document_source_type AS ENUM ('word', 'pdf', 'markdown', 'image', 'spreadsheet', 'csv', 'other')
CREATE TYPE parser_kind AS ENUM ('local', 'docmind')
CREATE TYPE build_status AS ENUM ('queued', 'parsing', 'preview_ready', 'indexing', 'ready', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'replacing')
CREATE TYPE build_task_type AS ENUM ('import', 'replace', 'reindex')
CREATE TYPE chunk_kind AS ENUM ('text', 'table', 'image')
CREATE TYPE metric_scope AS ENUM ('system', 'assistant', 'api_key', 'model')
CREATE TYPE model_kind AS ENUM ('llm', 'embedding', 'rerank')
CREATE TYPE validation_status AS ENUM ('untested', 'valid', 'invalid')
CREATE TYPE run_channel AS ENUM ('browser', 'api', 'retrieval_test')
CREATE TYPE run_status AS ENUM ('running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'insufficient_evidence')
CREATE TYPE usage_accuracy AS ENUM ('exact', 'estimated', 'unavailable')
CREATE TYPE run_step_kind AS ENUM ('query_rewrite', 'embedding', 'semantic_retrieval', 'keyword_retrieval', 'rrf_fusion', 'rerank', 'generation')

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	key_prefix VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_hint VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status api_key_status DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	allow_all_assistants BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	rate_limit_per_minute INTEGER DEFAULT 60 NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_by_role experience_role DEFAULT 'admin' NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_api_keys PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT rate_limit_positive CHECK (rate_limit_per_minute > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT expiry_after_creation CHECK (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_api_keys_key_prefix UNIQUE (key_prefix), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_api_keys_key_hash UNIQUE (key_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_api_keys_status_expires ON api_keys (status, expires_at)

CREATE TABLE daily_metrics (
	metric_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	scope metric_scope NOT NULL, 
	scope_id UUID, 
	channel VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL, 
	request_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	success_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	error_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	insufficient_evidence_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	prompt_tokens BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	completion_tokens BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	total_tokens BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	total_duration_ms BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	total_retrieved_chunks BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	max_duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_daily_metrics PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT request_count_nonnegative CHECK (request_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT success_count_nonnegative CHECK (success_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT error_count_nonnegative CHECK (error_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT insufficient_evidence_count_nonnegative CHECK (insufficient_evidence_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT prompt_tokens_nonnegative CHECK (prompt_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT completion_tokens_nonnegative CHECK (completion_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT total_tokens_nonnegative CHECK (total_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT total_duration_nonnegative CHECK (total_duration_ms >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT retrieved_chunks_nonnegative CHECK (total_retrieved_chunks >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT scope_id_presence CHECK ((scope = 'system' AND scope_id IS NULL) OR (scope <> 'system' AND scope_id IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_daily_metrics_system ON daily_metrics (metric_date, channel) WHERE scope = 'system'
CREATE INDEX ix_daily_metrics_date_scope ON daily_metrics (metric_date, scope)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_daily_metrics_scoped ON daily_metrics (metric_date, scope, scope_id, channel) WHERE scope_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE model_providers (
	key VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	api_style VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'openai_compatible' NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_api_key TEXT, 
	api_key_mask VARCHAR(100), 
	default_headers JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	capabilities JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	configuration_schema JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	is_builtin BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_model_providers PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_model_providers_key UNIQUE (key)
)

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	file_size_limit_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 104857600 NOT NULL, 
	page_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 500 NOT NULL, 
	batch_file_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 20 NOT NULL, 
	detailed_log_retention_days INTEGER DEFAULT 90 NOT NULL, 
	retain_daily_metrics BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	browser_session_days INTEGER DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL, 
	default_role experience_role DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_system_settings PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT system_settings_singleton CHECK (id = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT system_file_size_positive CHECK (file_size_limit_bytes > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT system_page_limit_positive CHECK (page_limit > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT system_batch_limit_positive CHECK (batch_file_limit > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT system_retention_positive CHECK (detailed_log_retention_days > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT system_browser_days_positive CHECK (browser_session_days > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE model_configs (
	provider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind model_kind NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	model_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	base_url VARCHAR(500), 
	encrypted_api_key TEXT, 
	api_key_mask VARCHAR(100), 
	extra_headers JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	extra_config JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	embedding_dimension INTEGER, 
	max_context_tokens INTEGER, 
	supports_streaming BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	supports_usage BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	validation_status validation_status DEFAULT 'untested' NOT NULL, 
	validated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	validation_latency_ms INTEGER, 
	validation_error TEXT, 
	total_requests BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_model_configs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_model_configs_name UNIQUE (name), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_model_configs_provider_kind_model UNIQUE (provider_id, kind, model_id), 
	CONSTRAINT embedding_dimension_positive CHECK (embedding_dimension IS NULL OR embedding_dimension > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT max_context_tokens_positive CHECK (max_context_tokens IS NULL OR max_context_tokens > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_model_configs_provider_id_model_providers FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES model_providers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_model_configs_provider_kind ON model_configs (provider_id, kind)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_model_configs_default_kind ON model_configs (kind) WHERE is_default AND enabled

CREATE TABLE assistants (
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	status assistant_status DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL, 
	llm_model_config_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rerank_model_config_id UUID, 
	system_prompt TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	insufficient_evidence_message TEXT DEFAULT '当前知识库未找到足够依据' NOT NULL, 
	enable_query_rewrite BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	semantic_top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL, 
	keyword_top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL, 
	rerank_top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 20 NOT NULL, 
	answer_top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 6 NOT NULL, 
	max_context_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 6000 NOT NULL, 
	relevance_threshold NUMERIC(5, 4) DEFAULT 0.5000 NOT NULL, 
	temperature NUMERIC(4, 3) DEFAULT 0.200 NOT NULL, 
	max_output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 2048 NOT NULL, 
	extra_config JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_assistants PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT semantic_top_k_positive CHECK (semantic_top_k > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT keyword_top_k_positive CHECK (keyword_top_k > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT rerank_top_k_positive CHECK (rerank_top_k > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT answer_top_k_positive CHECK (answer_top_k > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT max_context_tokens_positive CHECK (max_context_tokens > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT relevance_threshold_range CHECK (relevance_threshold >= 0 AND relevance_threshold <= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT temperature_range CHECK (temperature >= 0 AND temperature <= 2), 
	CONSTRAINT max_output_tokens_positive CHECK (max_output_tokens > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_assistants_alias UNIQUE (alias), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assistants_llm_model_config_id_model_configs FOREIGN KEY(llm_model_config_id) REFERENCES model_configs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assistants_rerank_model_config_id_model_configs FOREIGN KEY(rerank_model_config_id) REFERENCES model_configs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_assistants_status ON assistants (status)

CREATE TABLE knowledge_bases (
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	status knowledge_base_status DEFAULT 'empty' NOT NULL, 
	embedding_model_config_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	embedding_dimension INTEGER, 
	chunk_target_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 800 NOT NULL, 
	chunk_overlap_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 120 NOT NULL, 
	file_size_limit_bytes BIGINT DEFAULT 104857600 NOT NULL, 
	page_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 500 NOT NULL, 
	batch_file_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 20 NOT NULL, 
	document_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	chunk_count BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_knowledge_bases PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT chunk_target_tokens_positive CHECK (chunk_target_tokens > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT chunk_overlap_nonnegative CHECK (chunk_overlap_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT chunk_overlap_less_than_target CHECK (chunk_overlap_tokens < chunk_target_tokens), 
	CONSTRAINT file_size_limit_positive CHECK (file_size_limit_bytes > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT page_limit_positive CHECK (page_limit > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT batch_file_limit_positive CHECK (batch_file_limit > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_knowledge_bases_name UNIQUE (name), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_bases_embedding_model_config_id_model_configs FOREIGN KEY(embedding_model_config_id) REFERENCES model_configs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE api_key_assistants (
	api_key_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	assistant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_api_key_assistants PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_api_key_assistants_binding UNIQUE (api_key_id, assistant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_api_key_assistants_api_key_id_api_keys FOREIGN KEY(api_key_id) REFERENCES api_keys (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_api_key_assistants_assistant_id_assistants FOREIGN KEY(assistant_id) REFERENCES assistants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_api_key_assistants_assistant ON api_key_assistants (assistant_id)

CREATE TABLE assistant_knowledge_bases (
	assistant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	knowledge_base_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	retrieval_overrides JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_assistant_knowledge_bases PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_assistant_knowledge_bases_binding UNIQUE (assistant_id, knowledge_base_id), 
	CONSTRAINT priority_nonnegative CHECK (priority >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assistant_knowledge_bases_assistant_id_assistants FOREIGN KEY(assistant_id) REFERENCES assistants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assistant_knowledge_bases_knowledge_base_id_knowledge_bases FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_assistant_knowledge_bases_kb ON assistant_knowledge_bases (knowledge_base_id)

CREATE TABLE browser_sessions (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	selected_role experience_role DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	active_assistant_id UUID, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	client_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_browser_sessions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT expiry_after_creation CHECK (expires_at > created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_browser_sessions_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_browser_sessions_active_assistant_id_assistants FOREIGN KEY(active_assistant_id) REFERENCES assistants (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_browser_sessions_expires_at ON browser_sessions (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE documents (
	knowledge_base_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	source_type document_source_type NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(255), 
	current_content_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_documents PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_documents_knowledge_base_id_knowledge_bases FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_documents_knowledge_base ON documents (knowledge_base_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_documents_active_content_hash ON documents (knowledge_base_id, current_content_sha256) WHERE current_content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE chat_conversations (
	browser_session_id UUID, 
	assistant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255), 
	external_conversation_id VARCHAR(255), 
	external_user_id VARCHAR(255), 
	archived BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_chat_conversations PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_chat_conversations_browser_session_id_browser_sessions FOREIGN KEY(browser_session_id) REFERENCES browser_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_chat_conversations_assistant_id_assistants FOREIGN KEY(assistant_id) REFERENCES assistants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_chat_conversations_external_conversation_id UNIQUE (external_conversation_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_conversations_browser_updated ON chat_conversations (browser_session_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_conversations_assistant ON chat_conversations (assistant_id)

CREATE TABLE document_versions (
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	original_object_key VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	parsed_object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
	parser_kind parser_kind NOT NULL, 
	status build_status DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	needs_cloud_parse BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	data_egress_confirmed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	page_count INTEGER, 
	parser_result JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	preview_settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	activated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_document_versions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_document_versions_number UNIQUE (document_id, version_number), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_document_versions_content UNIQUE (document_id, content_sha256), 
	CONSTRAINT version_number_positive CHECK (version_number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT size_bytes_nonnegative CHECK (size_bytes >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT page_count_nonnegative CHECK (page_count IS NULL OR page_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT active_version_is_ready CHECK (NOT is_active OR status = 'ready'), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_document_versions_document_id_documents FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_document_versions_original_object_key UNIQUE (original_object_key)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_document_versions_status ON document_versions (status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_document_versions_one_active ON document_versions (document_id) WHERE is_active

CREATE TABLE build_tasks (
	knowledge_base_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_type build_task_type NOT NULL, 
	status build_status DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	progress SMALLINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	current_step VARCHAR(100), 
	celery_task_id VARCHAR(255), 
	attempt_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	task_settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	error_message TEXT, 
	error_details JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	queued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_build_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT progress_range CHECK (progress >= 0 AND progress <= 100), 
	CONSTRAINT attempt_count_nonnegative CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT max_attempts_positive CHECK (max_attempts > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_build_tasks_knowledge_base_id_knowledge_bases FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_build_tasks_document_version_id_document_versions FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_build_tasks_celery_task_id UNIQUE (celery_task_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_build_tasks_kb_status ON build_tasks (knowledge_base_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_build_tasks_one_open_per_version ON build_tasks (document_version_id) WHERE status IN ('queued', 'parsing', 'preview_ready', 'indexing', 'replacing')

CREATE TABLE knowledge_chunks (
	knowledge_base_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	embedding_model_config_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind chunk_kind DEFAULT 'text' NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_tsv TSVECTOR, 
	content_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title_path VARCHAR(255)[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	page_from INTEGER, 
	page_to INTEGER, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(255), 
	cell_range VARCHAR(100), 
	object_key VARCHAR(1024), 
	source_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	token_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	char_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	is_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	embedding_created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_knowledge_chunks PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_knowledge_chunks_ordinal UNIQUE (document_version_id, ordinal), 
	CONSTRAINT ordinal_nonnegative CHECK (ordinal >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT token_count_nonnegative CHECK (token_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT char_count_nonnegative CHECK (char_count >= 0),

	CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_chunks_knowledge_base_id_knowledge_bases FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_chunks_document_version_id_document_versions FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_chunks_embedding_model_config_id_model_configs FOREIGN KEY(embedding_model_config_id) REFERENCES model_configs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_chunks_version ON knowledge_chunks (document_version_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_chunks_content_tsv ON knowledge_chunks USING gin (content_tsv)
CREATE INDEX ix_knowledge_chunks_active_lookup ON knowledge_chunks (knowledge_base_id, embedding_model_config_id) WHERE is_active AND is_enabled

	llm_model_config_id UUID,

CREATE INDEX ix_run_records_assistant_started ON run_records (assistant_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_run_records_status_started ON run_records (status, started_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_run_records_api_key_started ON run_records (api_key_id, started_at)

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	run_id UUID, 
	role chat_role NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	citations JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	usage JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
